--[[
	Part-Icles Core  -  runtime engine.

	Call :Activate() once at script start to connect the Heartbeat loop.
	Call :Deactivate() at teardown to disconnect + clean up active emits.

	---- Emit (one item, no recursion) ----
	:Emit(item, link?, emitCtx?)
	   Fires one immediate emit on `item` (BasePart / Attachment / Model / Beam / etc.).
	   Use :AbsoluteEmit when you want children to fire too.

	:EmitAnimate(item, link?, emitCtx?)
	   Starts one Animate cycle on `item`. Visual animates in place (3D types) or
	   spawns a singleton clone (Screen / ImageLabel).

	:EnableEmit(item, link?, emitCtx?)
	   Honors authored EmitCount + EmitDelay + EmitDuration attributes. Fires the
	   burst then runs the loopBody for EmitDuration seconds.

	:EnableEmitAt(item, origin, options?) -> (handle: PlayHandle, duration: number?)
	   Like :EnableEmit but spawns from `origin` instead of `item`'s authored CFrame. One
	   transformed item; :AbsoluteEmitAt handles containers. Same origin forms, options and
	   handle as :AbsoluteEmitAt.

	---- Recursive emit (item + all descendants) ----
	:AbsoluteEmit(item, _parentFiredPE?, emitCtx?) -> duration: number?
	   Fires every emitter under `item` (transformed items via :EnableEmit, raw PE / Trail
	   / Beam via native APIs). Walks the descendant tree, deduping via _parentFiredPE.
	   Returns total real-time duration in seconds (or nil for infinite  -  AnimateLoop
	   unbounded, Timescale stuck at 0). Pair with .await(n) for an emit-and-wait pattern.

	:AbsoluteEmitAt(item, origin, options?) -> (handle: PlayHandle, duration: number?)
	   Recursive form of :EnableEmitAt. `origin` is a CFrame, a Vector3 (position only) or an
	   instance with a frame (followed live through EmitDelay). A transformed root spawns from
	   the origin; a container keeps its authored layout: every transformed descendant spawns
	   at origin x its offset from the container pivot, and raw PE / Trail / Beam ride a
	   stripped clone placed at the origin. UseFullOrigin=false translates only. Nodes without
	   a position (Beam / Trail / lights / screen types / Animate mode) warn once and emit in
	   place. options: Link / LinkMode / EmitParent apply to this play only (Persist=true
	   writes them to the source); Count / Delay / Duration override the authored attributes
	   for this play; OriginResolver, UseFullOrigin, IgnoreLink, LinkOverride, ChainCtx.
	   Returns a per-play ghost handle (:Disable / :SoftDisable / :SetTimescale /
	   :GetParticles / :IsAlive / :Wait, scoped to THIS play, never the shared source) and
	   the total duration (nil for infinite). A rejected call warns and returns an inert
	   handle, never nil.

	---- Enable / Disable (no emit  -  just on/off state) ----
	:Enable(item, link?, duration?, emitCtx?)
	   Starts the continuous-emit loopBody for `duration` seconds (defaults to math.huge).
	   Animate-mode short-circuits to AnimateLoop=true + :EmitAnimate.

	:Disable(item)
	   Hard stop on `item`: cancels loops, sets cfg.Enabled=false, cancels PE/Trail native
	   gens, AND reclaims every live clone now (sweeps ActiveEmits + finishes linger).

	:SoftDisable(item)
	   Soft stop on `item`: halt new emission but leave live clones to age out their Lifetime
	   on the Heartbeat (no ActiveEmits sweep, no linger destroy, no cancelAnimation).

	:AbsoluteEnable(item)
	   Recursive enable. Transformed item → cfg.Enabled=true + :Enable(math.huge), sets
	   _PartIclePlaying gate so the EnabledLoop listener doesn't double-fire. Raw PE / Trail
	   / Beam / Highlight descendants get Enabled=true. Containers (Folder, Model, BasePart)
	   walk children with the covered flag so descendants aren't double-toggled.

	:AbsoluteDisable(item)
	   Recursive SOFT disable. Transformed descendants → :SoftDisable (new emission stops,
	   live particles finish their Lifetime). Raw PE / Trail / Beam / Highlight descendants
	   get Enabled=false (native soft stop). For instant reclaim, call :Disable per item.

	---- Timescale (per-particle time distortion) ----
	:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration?, permanent?)
	   Override Timescale to `scale` for `duration` seconds (or until next ClearTimescale
	   if `permanent`). Wins over authored Timescale graph during its window.

	:ClearTimescale(item)
	   Remove the override; authored Timescale graph (or 1) resumes.

	:AbsoluteSetTimescale / :AbsoluteClearTimescale
	   Recursive variants over `item` + transformed descendants.

	---- Authoring / texture / state ----
	:Transform(part)                                  -  convert into a Part-Icle emitter
	:TransformModel(model, typeDef)                   -  Model variant
	:Preload(root, force?)                            -  pin textures for upcoming emit
	:Deload(root, force?)                             -  release texture pins
	:GetData(item)                                    -  flat data table read from config
	:GetFolder() / :GetPoolFolder()                   -  runtime folder accessors
	:ReapplyLink(pData)                               -  per-frame link CFrame writer

	---- Statics + sub-services ----
	.await(n)                                         -  yields task for n seconds; nil = no-op
	.parseDuration(raw)                               -  parse "min,max" range string to number
	.LinkService                                      -  standalone link-tracking service
	.TransformCompleted                               -  BindableEvent fired post-:Transform

	---- emitCtx ----
	emitCtx (optional table threaded through every emit path):
	  ChainCtx            = { ChainId, Depth } event-chain context
	  EmitIndex           = burst-index (set by EnableEmit's count loop)
	  EmitCount           = burst-count
	  EventOriginCF       = origin override (set by EnableEmitAt / AbsoluteEmitAt)
	  EventOriginResolver = live-resolver function fired at spawn time
	  UseFullOrigin       = bool; AtCFrame includes rotation
	  IgnoreLink          = bool; bypass authored Link weld
	  Overrides           = per-play Count / Delay / Duration / LinkMode / EmitParent (EmitAt options)
]]

local Log = require(script.Log)

local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local _RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Particles)

local Particle = {}
Particle.Beam = {}
-- Focus tracking; connections stored so Deactivate can release them. Client-only.
Particle._focused = true
Particle._unfocusedAt = 0
if _RunService:IsClient() then
	Particle._focusConn = UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(function() Particle._focused = true; Particle._unfocusedAt = 0 end)
	Particle._blurConn = UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() Particle._focused = false; Particle._unfocusedAt = os.clock() end)
end

-- Engine state.
Particle.ActiveEmits = {}    -- pData array for live clones; Heartbeat walks this
Particle.ActiveLoops = {}    -- item → Enable-loop task thread
Particle.ActiveAnimates = {} -- item → pData (max 1 cycle per source)
-- Chain-driven duration loops run detached so parallel chain fires don't cancel each other.
Particle.ActiveChainLoops = {}
-- EvenDistribution rolling-cycle state, keyed by _EvenCycleId so all clones of one
-- authored emitter share + advance one counter across discrete + nested emissions.
Particle._evenCycleStore = {}
Particle.Connection = nil
Particle._engineGen = 0
-- Hard cap on concurrent particles; user Module code still runs at cap.
Particle.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES = 1000
Particle._capWarnLastAt = 0
-- PartLife linger visuals (post-pData) count toward the cap.
Particle._lingerVisualCount = 0
-- First-emit-per-RT preload memo (ImageEmit). Weak-keyed so destroyed RT GCs cleanly.
Particle._preloadedAssets = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

-- Mixin pattern: sub-modules attach methods to Particle.
require(script.GetData)(Particle)
require(script.EmitOverrides)(Particle)
require(script.Transform)(Particle)
require(script.Update)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateAttachment)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateBeam)(Particle)
-- Timescale loaded before Emit mixins so Particle._seedTsOverride is attached when those emit-site seed calls run.
require(script.Timescale)(Particle)
require(script.Emit)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAttachment)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAnimate)(Particle)
require(script.EmitModel)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateModel)(Particle)
require(script.PointLight)(Particle)
require(script.Sound)(Particle)
require(script.Highlight)(Particle)
require(script.Lightning)(Particle)
require(script.CameraShake)(Particle)
require(script.Rocks)(Particle)
require(script.Rope)(Particle)
require(script.Distortion)(Particle)
require(script.TrailEmitter)(Particle)
require(script.ScreenEmit)(Particle)
require(script.ImageEmit)(Particle)
require(script.LinkTrack)(Particle)
require(script.Orientation)(Particle)
require(script.ZOffset)(Particle)
-- Engine mixin owns Activate / Deactivate / GetFolder / GetPoolFolder (big Heartbeat
-- callback split out to keep init.luau under the 500-line code cap).
require(script.Engine)(Particle)
-- EngineReplay owns _replayAnimateCycle (AnimateLoop reset + replay), split from Engine.
require(script.EngineReplay)(Particle)
-- PreSimulate owns PreSimulateForward/PreSimulateAttachmentForward, split from Transform.
require(script.PreSimulate)(Particle)
-- RegisterEmit owns Particle:_registerEmit (universal pData insertion chokepoint + play-token
-- stamp), split out of Lifecycle to keep both under the 500-line cap.
require(script.RegisterEmit)(Particle)
-- Lifecycle loaded last (touches earlier mixins).
require(script.Lifecycle)(Particle)
require(script.LifecycleRelease)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAt)(Particle)

-- Once-per-session warning fired when a public emit-creating method is called
-- before :Activate(). Particles will be created but the Heartbeat isn't connected,
-- so they'll never advance. Helps scripters spot the missing :Activate() call
-- instead of debugging invisible particles.
function Particle:_warnIfNotActivated(methodName)
	if self.Connection then return end
	if self._notActivatedWarned then return end
	self._notActivatedWarned = true
	Log.warn(string.format(
		"[Part-Icles] :%s() called before :Activate()  -  particles will not update until the engine is activated. Call Particle:Activate() once at startup.",
		methodName
	))
end

-- Apply Orientation + ZOffset on emit frame to avoid a 1-frame snap.
function Particle:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
	-- Seed _postUpdateCF from spawn pose so frame-1 overlays don't compound on themselves.
	local hasO = pData.Orientation and pData.Orientation ~= "None"
	local hasZ = pData.ZOffset and pData.ZOffset ~= 0
	if hasO or hasZ then pData._postUpdateCF = (t == "Model") and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame end
	if hasO then self:ApplyOrientation(pData, 1/60, camPos) end
	if hasZ then self:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos) end
end

-- Activate / Deactivate / GetFolder / GetPoolFolder live in Modules/Part/Engine.luau (mixin).

-- One-shot emit. Dispatches to the per-type EmitX. `link` is optional  -  for types that support
-- Linking (Parts / Attachment / Model), pass the instance whose CFrame the emit is tied to.
-- `emitCtx` is an optional context table propagated by the Events runtime + EnableEmitAt:
--   { ChainCtx = {ChainId, Depth}, EmitIndex = 1-based, EventOriginCF = CFrame, IgnoreLink = bool }
-- EventOriginCF + IgnoreLink are honoured by EmitPart / EmitAttachment / EmitModel for origin
-- override. Other types ignore those fields and emit at their authored CFrame.
function Particle:Emit(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	self:_warnIfNotActivated("Emit")
	-- Hard cap on concurrent particles. Skip the visual emit but let Events.fire's
	-- user-Module spawn continue (Module is spawned separately, not from this dispatch).
	-- Once-per-second warn so a sustained overflow doesn't flood Output with one warn
	-- per dropped emit.
	-- Lingering visuals (PartLife > 0 path in Lifecycle) outlive their ActiveEmits entry
	-- but still consume world resources, so they count against the cap. _lingerVisualCount
	-- is incremented when a visual enters linger, decremented on destroy (or via
	-- _lingerCounted attribute idempotency).
	local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
	if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (self._capWarnLastAt or 0) >= 1 then
			self._capWarnLastAt = now
			Log.warn(("[Part-Icles] active particle cap (%d) reached  -  new emits skipped (user Module code still runs)."):format(cap))
		end
		return
	end
	if item:IsA("Beam") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then
		self:EmitBeam(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Beam") or (item:IsA("Trail") and not item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")) then
		-- directAccess Beam (BeamNative) or directAccess Trail: no emit pipeline. Schedule the
		-- enable-for-Duration toggle that doEmitOnce uses so API-level Particle:Emit has parity.
		-- Trail's EmitDuration is sometimes a "min,max" string  -  take max for the schedule.
		local raw, d = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0
		if typeof(raw) == "number" then d = raw
		elseif raw ~= nil then local m1, m2 = tostring(raw):match("([%-%.%d]+)%s*,%s*([%-%.%d]+)")
			d = (m1 and m2) and math.max(tonumber(m1) or 0, tonumber(m2) or 0) or (tonumber(tostring(raw)) or 0)
		end
		if d > 0 then
			task.delay(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0, function()
				if not (item and item.Parent) then return end
				item.Enabled = true
				task.delay(d, function() if item and item.Parent then item.Enabled = false end end)
			end)
		end
	elseif item:IsA("Trail") then
		self:EmitTrail(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Light") then
		self:EmitPointLight(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Sound") then
		self:EmitSound(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then
		self:EmitHighlight(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
		self:EmitAttachment(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Model") then
		self:EmitModel(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		self:EmitBlur(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		self:EmitBloom(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		self:EmitColorCorrection(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		self:EmitAtmosphere(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		self:EmitImageLabel(item, link, emitCtx)
	-- Lightning / CameraShake / Rocks / Rope before the BasePart fallback or they route to EmitPart.
	elseif Particle._isLightning(item) then
		self:EmitLightning(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isCameraShake(item) then
		self:EmitCameraShake(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isRocks(item) then
		self:EmitRocks(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isRope(item) then
		self:EmitRope(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isDistortion(item) then
		self:EmitDistortion(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
		self:EmitPart(item, link, emitCtx)
	end
	-- Unknown / unwired types silently no-op.
end

-- Particle:Enable, Particle:Disable, Particle:EmitAnimate, Particle:EnableEmit, and the
-- local cancelAnimation helper live in Modules/Part/Lifecycle.luau (loaded as a mixin above).

-- Recursive fire-everything-under-root. For a transformed item, runs EnableEmit (full emit timing).
-- For a raw ParticleEmitter / Trail, fires its native API directly. Walks descendants so one call
-- on a Folder/Model containing many emitters fires them all. `_parentFiredPE` is an internal flag
-- that prevents double-firing when an ancestor already covered a subtree's native PEs via
-- ParticlesMod.EnableEmit (which internally uses GetDescendants).
local _Duration = require(script.Duration)

-- Yield helper. Companion to Particle:AbsoluteEmit's duration return value.
-- Called as `Particle.await(n)` (no colon). Nil / non-positive durations are no-ops
-- so `Particle.await(Particle:AbsoluteEmit(item))` is safe for infinite-cycle emitters.
function Particle.await(n)
	if n == nil then return end
	if type(n) ~= "number" then return end
	if n <= 0 then return end
	task.wait(n)
end

-- _absoluteEmitFire dispatches the actual emit recursion; AbsoluteEmit wraps it +
-- computes the true wall-clock duration. Split keeps the recursive Activate-warn
-- to fire once at the top level instead of every nested descendant call.
function Particle:_absoluteEmitFire(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		self:EnableEmit(item, nil, emitCtx)
		return
	end

	-- Engine-session predicate threaded into native PE/Trail helpers so a delayed
	-- :Emit / :Enable doesn't fire after Particle:Deactivate.
	local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()

	-- Raw ParticleEmitter: fire directly. EmitCount defaults to 1 when the attribute is absent,
	-- matching the Studio Emit button's inline behavior. tonumber coerces string-typed attrs
	-- (e.g. EmitCount="5" set via Studio's attribute UI) so the `<= 0` comparison can't error.
	if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		if _parentFiredPE then return end
		local count = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")) or 1
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local emitDuration = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		-- Zero-as-zero  -  see Modules/Part/Particles.luau.
		if count <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then return end
		-- Capture the native gen at schedule time so an AbsoluteDisable during EmitDelay
		-- invalidates this delayed start instead of resurrecting the emitter past the delay.
		local scheduledGen = ParticlesMod.ReadNativeGen(item)
		local function doEmit()
			if not alive() or not ParticlesMod.IsNativeGenCurrent(item, scheduledGen) then return end
			if count > 0 then item:Emit(count) end
			-- SetEnabledForDuration schedules a native-gen-tokened delayed-off so the
			-- cleanup still runs even after engine death, while a newer emit session
			-- bumping the gen prevents this closure from clobbering its window.
			if emitDuration > 0 then ParticlesMod.SetEnabledForDuration(item, emitDuration) end
		end
		if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
		return
	end

	-- Raw Trail: delegate to existing single-instance helper (parses EmitDuration range).
	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		if _parentFiredPE then return end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(item, alive)
		return
	end

	-- Raw Beam: continuous-streak rendering between authored Attachment0 / Attachment1.
	-- EmitDuration attribute gates a timed Enable-for-duration window; absent / zero leaves
	-- the authored Enabled state alone. No EmitCount semantic (Beams stream, not burst).
	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		if _parentFiredPE then return end
		local emitDuration = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		if emitDuration > 0 then
			local scheduledGen = ParticlesMod.ReadNativeGen(item)
			local function doEmit()
				if not alive() or not ParticlesMod.IsNativeGenCurrent(item, scheduledGen) then return end
				ParticlesMod.SetEnabledForDuration(item, emitDuration)
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
		end
		return
	end

	-- Fire native PEs for BaseParts and Attachments.
	-- Skip if a parent already called EnableEmit (which uses GetDescendants, so our PEs are already covered).
	local shouldFirePE = (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not _parentFiredPE
	if shouldFirePE then ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(item, alive) end

	-- Propagate the "covered" state: if we fired here OR an ancestor fired, children are already
	-- covered. The `or _parentFiredPE` term keeps a suppressed intermediate (e.g. an Attachment
	-- inside an already-fired Part) from clearing the flag  -  descendant PEs would double-fire.
	local firedCovered = shouldFirePE or _parentFiredPE
	for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			continue
		end
		self:_absoluteEmitFire(child, firedCovered, emitCtx)
	end
end

-- Recursive emit. Walks `item` + descendants firing every emitter:
--   - Transformed item → :EnableEmit (honors EmitCount + EmitDelay + EmitDuration).
--   - Raw ParticleEmitter → :Emit(count) + Enabled-for-duration window.
--   - Raw Trail → :EnableEmitSingle.
--   - Raw Beam → SetEnabledForDuration.
--   - BasePart / Attachment / Model → ParticlesMod.EnableEmit covers all native PE/Trail
--     descendants at once; recursion threads `firedCovered` so nested raw emitters
--     aren't double-fired.
-- Returns total real-time wallclock duration in seconds across every spawned effect
-- (EmitDelay + EmitDuration + Timescale-distorted Lifetime + PartLife, recursing
-- nested transformed descendants). Returns nil when any branch is effectively infinite
-- (AnimateLoop unbounded, Timescale=0, or Timescale terminal value with wrong sign).
-- Pair with .await(n) for emit-and-wait. emitCtx threads through (see file header).
function Particle:AbsoluteEmit(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
	self:_warnIfNotActivated("AbsoluteEmit")
	if not item then return 0 end
	self:_absoluteEmitFire(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
	return _Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, 0)
end

-- Particle:EnableEmitAt / AbsoluteEmitAt live in EmitAt.luau (mixin).

-- AbsoluteEnable / AbsoluteDisable live in Lifecycle.luau alongside Particle:Disable so the
-- single-item and recursive-state APIs share a file. Same recursion shape as AbsoluteEmit
-- (Transformed → engine path; raw PE/Trail → native .Enabled; container → walk descendants
-- skipping transformed sub-emitter RTs).

-- Preload / Deload API  -  texture-pin every texture-bearing item under `root`. Use `Preload` before
-- a skill cast so the first emit doesn't stutter on texture decode; `Deload` after the skill is
-- permanently retired to free GPU memory. Only items with `PreloadTexture=true` are touched unless
-- `force=true` is passed, in which case every transformed item / raw PE / raw Trail under root
-- gets pinned regardless of opt-in.
local _TexturePin = require(script.TexturePin)
local function _isPreloadable(i) return i:GetAttribute("Transformed") or i:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or i:IsA("Trail") end
local function _walk(root, force, action)
	if not root then return end
	local function visit(inst)
		if _isPreloadable(inst) and (force or inst:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == true) then action(inst) end
		for _, c in inst:GetChildren() do visit(c) end
	end
	visit(root)
end
-- Texture-pin every PreloadTexture=true descendant under `root` so the first emit
-- after Preload doesn't stall on texture decode. `force=true` pins every transformed
-- item / raw PE / raw Trail regardless of opt-in.
function Particle:Preload(root, force) _walk(root, force, _TexturePin.pinSubtree) end
-- Inverse of Preload; releases pinned textures so the engine can free GPU memory.
function Particle:Deload(root, force) _walk(root, force, _TexturePin.unpinSubtree) end

-- Standalone LinkService API. Reuses LinkMode dispatch on arbitrary BaseParts /
-- Models / Attachments  -  independent from the particle emit pipeline.
Particle.LinkService = require(script.LinkService)
-- Console gate: `Particle.Log.enabled = false` silences the runtime's prints / warns (plugin: Settings toggle).
Particle.Log = Log
Particle.parseDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration

-- Mutate the source item's authored Link/EmitParent. Use these for persistent
-- runtime wiring; per-call EnableEmitAt/AbsoluteEmitAt options are ephemeral unless Persist=true.

-- target: Instance -> Link.Value + LinkSource="Object"
--         "camera"  -> LinkSource="Camera"
--         nil       -> LinkSource="None" + clear Link.Value
-- mode: optional, "Follow" / "Pivot" / "Weld" / "WeldWithoutRotation"
function Particle:SetLink(item, target, mode)
	if not item or not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	if target == "camera" then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "Camera") end)
	elseif target == nil then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None") end)
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		if lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") then lk.Value = nil end
	elseif typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		if not lk then
			lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			lk.Name = "Link"
			lk.Parent = item
		end
		lk.Value = target
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "Object") end)
	end
	if mode then pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkMode", mode) end) end
end

-- parent: Instance -> EmitParent.Value (cloned visuals go there)
--         nil      -> remove EmitParent (engine default emit folder used)
function Particle:SetEmitParent(item, parent)
	if not item or not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	if parent == nil then
		local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
		if ep then pcall(function() ep:Destroy() end) end
		return
	end
	if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then return end
	local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
	if not ep then
		ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Parent = item
	end
	ep.Value = parent
end

-- Luau autocomplete + IntelliSense: the mixin pattern `require(script.X)(Particle)`
-- attaches methods at runtime, which Luau's static analyzer cannot follow. The cast
-- below tells the analyzer the public shape so users typing `Part:` see every API.
-- Field types are conservative (Instance + any) since most accept multiple authoring
-- types via internal dispatch (BasePart / Attachment / Model / Beam / etc.).
export type ParticleAPI = {
	-- Lifecycle
	Activate: (self: ParticleAPI) -> (),
	Deactivate: (self: ParticleAPI) -> (),
	Enable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, duration: number?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	Disable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	SoftDisable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteEnable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteDisable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),

	-- Emit
	Emit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EmitAnimate: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EnableEmit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EnableEmitAt: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, origin: CFrame | Vector3 | Instance, options: {[string]: any}?) -> (any, number?),
	AbsoluteEmit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, _parentFiredPE: boolean?, emitCtx: any?) -> number?,
	AbsoluteEmitAt: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, origin: CFrame | Vector3 | Instance, options: {[string]: any}?) -> (any, number?),

	-- Timescale
	SetTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, scale: number, duration: number?, permanent: boolean?) -> (),
	ClearTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteSetTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, scale: number, duration: number?, permanent: boolean?) -> (),
	AbsoluteClearTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),

	-- Authoring + utilities
	Transform: (self: ParticleAPI, part: Instance) -> (),
	TransformModel: (self: ParticleAPI, model: Model, typeDef: any) -> (),
	Preload: (self: ParticleAPI, root: Instance, force: boolean?) -> (),
	Deload: (self: ParticleAPI, root: Instance, force: boolean?) -> (),
	SetLink: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, target: (Instance | string)?, mode: string?) -> (),
	SetEmitParent: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, parent: Instance?) -> (),
	GetData: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> any,
	GetFolder: (self: ParticleAPI) -> Folder,
	GetPoolFolder: (self: ParticleAPI) -> Folder,
	ReapplyLink: (self: ParticleAPI, pData: any) -> (),

	-- Statics
	await: (n: number?) -> (),
	parseDuration: (raw: any) -> number?,
	LinkService: typeof(require(script.LinkService)),
	TransformCompleted: BindableEvent,
	Beam: {[string]: any},
	MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES: number,
	ActiveEmits: {any},
	ActiveLoops: {[Instance]: thread},
	ActiveAnimates: {[Instance]: any},
}

return Particle :: ParticleAPI

--[[
	AxisLinks  -  graph-axis alias pass shared between EmitPart and AnimateLoop refresh.
	When two axes are linked, the follower's graph + seed point at the primary's, so they track
	tick-for-tick. `sanitize` is the chokepoint that filters cross-group / self / chain / cycle.
]]

local AxisLinks = {}

local GRAPH_FOLLOWERS = {"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ","RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ","PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"}

-- Same-group axis link metadata. Cross-group links rejected at sanitize.
local AXIS_GROUPS = {
	{"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"},
	{"RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ"},
	{"PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"},
	{"RotX","RotY","RotZ"},
	{"PosX","PosY","PosZ"},
}
local AXIS_GROUP_OF = {}
for _, group in ipairs(AXIS_GROUPS) do
	local set = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(group) do set[a] = true end
	for _, a in ipairs(group) do AXIS_GROUP_OF[a] = set end
end

-- Resolve a follower's link target. Returns nil for no-link / self-link / cross-group / chain / cycle.
local function resolveAxisLink(raw, follower)
	local primary = raw and raw[follower] or nil
	if not primary or primary == "" or primary == follower then return nil end
	local group = AXIS_GROUP_OF[follower]
	if not group or not group[primary] then return nil end
	local primaryLink = raw[primary]
	if primaryLink and primaryLink ~= "" and primaryLink ~= primary and group[primaryLink] then return nil end
	return primary
end

-- Sanitize raw {axisKey -> rawAttrString} into resolved {follower -> primary or nil}.
function AxisLinks.sanitize(raw)
	local resolved = {}
	for _, group in ipairs(AXIS_GROUPS) do
		for _, a in ipairs(group) do resolved[a] = resolveAxisLink(raw, a) end
	end
	return resolved
end

function AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(graphs, seeds, axisLinks)
	if not axisLinks or not graphs or not seeds then return end
	for _, follower in ipairs(GRAPH_FOLLOWERS) do
		local primary = axisLinks[follower]
		if primary and primary ~= follower and graphs[primary] and seeds[primary] then
			graphs[follower] = graphs[primary]
			seeds[follower] = seeds[primary]
		end
	end
end

-- Range-axis sampler. Primary axes sampled once, linked followers reuse primary's scalar.
-- EvenDistribution: `{axis}Even` + emitCtx → base spread t = i/count (skips Min so circular
-- ranges don't collide at 0/360); count==1 with NO active cycle → midpoint. A per-emission
-- rolling-cycle OFFSET (EvenOffsetIdx/N_Pos or _Rot) shifts the whole spread by
-- (offIdx-1)/(N*count) each emission — a gap/N step that fills the gaps over N emissions,
-- wrapping mod 1. When a cycle IS active, idx 1 (off==0) must NOT take the midpoint shortcut:
-- it flows through the formula to t=1 (the edge) so the rolling sweep stays continuous.
function AxisLinks.sampleRangeAxes(data, axisLinks, axes, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local emitIndex = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitIndex
	local emitCount = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitCount
	local first = axes[1] or ""
	local prefix = first:sub(1, 3)
	local offIdx, offN
	if prefix == "Pos" then
		offIdx = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetIdx_Pos
		offN = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetN_Pos
	elseif prefix == "Rot" then
		offIdx = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetIdx_Rot
		offN = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetN_Rot
	end
	local hasEvenCtx = emitIndex and emitCount and emitCount > 0
	local sampled = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(axes) do
		local primary = axisLinks and axisLinks[k]
		if not primary then
			local even = data[k .. "Even"] == true
			if even and hasEvenCtx then
				local r = data[k]
				local t
				local off = (offN and offN > 0) and ((offIdx - 1) / (offN * emitCount)) or 0
				local cycleActive = offN ~= nil and offN > 0
				if emitCount == 1 and off == 0 and not cycleActive then
					t = 0.5
				else
					t = emitIndex / emitCount + off
					if t > 1 then t = t - 1 end -- t < 2 guaranteed; single wrap to [0,1)
				end
				sampled[k] = r.Min + (r.Max - r.Min) * t
			else
				sampled[k] = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data[k])
			end
		end
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(axes) do
		if sampled[k] == nil then
			local primary = axisLinks and axisLinks[k]
			sampled[k] = (primary and sampled[primary]) or RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data[k])
		end
	end
	return sampled
end

-- AnimateLoop refresh: rebuild Graphs from freshData, re-roll seeds, re-apply axis aliases.
function AxisLinks.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds(pData, freshData, GraphMod)
	if not pData.Graphs then return end
	for k, _ in pairs(pData.Graphs) do
		if freshData[k] ~= nil then pData.Graphs[k] = freshData[k] end
	end
	if pData.Seeds then for k, _ in pairs(pData.Seeds) do
		if pData.Graphs[k] then pData.Seeds[k] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(pData.Graphs[k]) end
	end end
	AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds, freshData.AxisLinks)
end

return AxisLinks

--[[
	CameraShake Mixin  -  Emit + Animate + Update for positional camera-shake emitters.

	No visual clone: pData.VisualPart is nil (every engine teardown path guards it).
	Each live shake samples six decorrelated Perlin channels per frame, attenuates
	by camera distance to the emitter (ShakeFalloff, 0 = global), and adds the
	result to CameraShake/Apply's accumulator; Engine applies the summed offset to
	workspace.CurrentCamera once per step. Multiple shakes sum linearly (small-angle
	Euler addition on the rotational channels).

	Nested emitters UNDER a shake's RenderTemplate never fire (no clone to link) -
	shake AS a nested child of Part/Model/Lightning works and its falloff origin
	rides the moving parent clone.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Apply = require(script.Apply)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

-- Non-integer channel offsets (math.noise returns 0 on the integer lattice).
local KX, KY, KZ = 0.17, 137.7, 291.3
local KRX, KRY, KRZ = 431.1, 557.5, 683.9

local warnedServer = false

return function(Particle)

-- CameraShake discriminator; shared by init.luau Emit dispatch + Lifecycle EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isCameraShake(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") == true
end

local function buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	local seeds = {
		ShakeAmplitude = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ShakeAmplitude),
		ShakeRotAmplitude = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ShakeRotAmplitude),
		ShakeFrequency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ShakeFrequency),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local pData = {
		Type = "CameraShake",
		VisualPart = nil,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			ShakeAmplitude = data.ShakeAmplitude,
			ShakeRotAmplitude = data.ShakeRotAmplitude,
			ShakeFrequency = data.ShakeFrequency,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),
		-- Noise phase = integral of ShakeFrequency over effective time (reverse timescale rewinds it).
		_shakePhase = 0,
		_falloff = data.ShakeFalloff or 0,
		_shakeSeed = math.random() * 997 + 0.5,
		_lastOriginPos = item.Position,
	}
	-- Event origin override (EnableEmitAt / Events AtPosition chains): falloff
	-- measures from the resolved origin for the shake's whole life.
	if emitCtx then
		local originCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		originCF = originCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if originCF then pData._originOverride = originCF.Position end
	end
	return pData
end

function Particle:EmitCameraShake(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	-- Server has no camera; Heartbeat-driven server engines skip shakes entirely.
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		if not warnedServer then
			warnedServer = true
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] CameraShake ignored on the server (no camera).")
		end
		return
	end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Nested emit: falloff origin rides the emitted parent clone.
	pData._parentLink = link
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: singleton looping shake per source (no clone at all).
function Particle:EmitCameraShakeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	pData._parentLink = link
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Per-frame update: sample envelopes (step-gated), noise channels (every frame,
-- smoothness), attenuate by distance, accumulate. Zero allocation.
function Particle:UpdateCameraShake(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Lightning/init.luau UpdateLightning.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)
	if isDying then return true end

	-- Falloff origin: live parent clone → live source → frozen last-known.
	local origin = pData._originOverride
	if not origin then
		local link = pData._parentLink
		if link and link.Parent then
			origin = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link).Position
		else
			local src = pData._sourceItem
			origin = (src and src.Parent) and src.Position or pData._lastOriginPos
		end
	end
	pData._lastOriginPos = origin

	local li = newEff / lifeTime
	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(li, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local si = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		pData._curAmp = pData.Graphs.ShakeAmplitude and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.ShakeAmplitude, pData.Seeds.ShakeAmplitude) or 0
		pData._curRotAmp = pData.Graphs.ShakeRotAmplitude and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.ShakeRotAmplitude, pData.Seeds.ShakeRotAmplitude) or 0
		pData._curFreq = pData.Graphs.ShakeFrequency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.ShakeFrequency, pData.Seeds.ShakeFrequency) or 10
	end
	if not pData._timeFrozen then
		pData._shakePhase = (pData._shakePhase or 0) + dtTs * (pData._curFreq or 10)
	end

	local atten = 1
	local falloff = pData._falloff
	if falloff > 0 then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			atten = math.clamp(1 - (cam.CFrame.Position - origin).Magnitude / falloff, 0, 1)
		else
			atten = 0
		end
	end

	local amp = (pData._curAmp or 0) * atten
	local rotAmp = math.rad(pData._curRotAmp or 0) * atten
	if amp ~= 0 or rotAmp ~= 0 then
		local t = pData._shakePhase
		local s = pData._shakeSeed
		Apply.accumulate(
			amp * math.noise(t, s, KX), amp * math.noise(t, s, KY), amp * math.noise(t, s, KZ),
			rotAmp * math.noise(t, s, KRX), rotAmp * math.noise(t, s, KRY), rotAmp * math.noise(t, s, KRZ))
	end

	return false
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch). Graphs/seeds/LifeTime are
-- refreshed by the generic replay; only the scalar shake fields re-read here.
-- Noise seed and phase persist so the loop reads as one continuous rumble.
function Particle:_refreshCameraShakeAnimate(pData, freshData)
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._falloff = freshData.ShakeFalloff or 0
	pData._curAmp = nil
	pData._curRotAmp = nil
	pData._curFreq = nil
	pData.CurrentStep = -1
end

end

--[[
	CameraShake/Apply  -  module-level camera-offset accumulator.
	Every live CameraShake pData adds its frame contribution via accumulate();
	Engine calls applyFrame() ONCE per step after the update loop, composing
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() * newOffset.

	Removal ALWAYS composes, even when something else moved the camera since our
	last write. Studio's edit-mode camera controller builds each new pose on the
	current CFrame (our offset baked in), so unconditional removal is what keeps
	the camera level after the shake. Never compare CFrames for equality here:
	the engine orthonormalizes on write, so read-back is not bit-identical and an
	equality guard skips removal every frame (offsets then random-walk into a
	permanent tilt). Play-mode camera scripts rewrite the camera wholesale each
	frame BEFORE us (priority 200 vs our Last+1), so the stale removal there is a
	bounded one-frame error the next rewrite wipes.
]]

local Apply = {}

local sumX, sumY, sumZ = 0, 0, 0
local rotX, rotY, rotZ = 0, 0, 0
local prevApplied = CFrame.identity
local hasApplied = false
local appliedCam = nil

-- Translation in studs (camera-local), rotation in radians.
function Apply.accumulate(dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz)
	sumX += dx; sumY += dy; sumZ += dz
	rotX += rx; rotY += ry; rotZ += rz
end

local function clearState()
	sumX, sumY, sumZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	prevApplied = CFrame.identity
	hasApplied = false
	appliedCam = nil
end

function Apply.applyFrame()
	local active = sumX ~= 0 or sumY ~= 0 or sumZ ~= 0 or rotX ~= 0 or rotY ~= 0 or rotZ ~= 0
	if not hasApplied and not active then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		clearState()
		return
	end
	-- Camera swapped since our last write: the offset lives on the OLD camera.
	-- Remove it there; never compose the stale inverse on the new one.
	if appliedCam and appliedCam ~= cam then
		if hasApplied and appliedCam.Parent then
			pcall(function() appliedCam.CFrame = appliedCam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() end)
		end
		prevApplied = CFrame.identity
		hasApplied = false
	end
	local newOffset = CFrame.new(sumX, sumY, sumZ) * CFrame.fromOrientation(rotX, rotY, rotZ)
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() * newOffset
	prevApplied = newOffset
	hasApplied = active
	appliedCam = cam
	sumX, sumY, sumZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
end

-- Synchronous restore + full clear. Engine Deactivate calls this; after it the
-- accumulator is cold and applyFrame's idle early-out costs a few compares.
function Apply.reset()
	if hasApplied and appliedCam and appliedCam.Parent then
		pcall(function() appliedCam.CFrame = appliedCam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() end)
	end
	clearState()
end

return Apply

--[[
	DecalLayers  -  per-decal appearance + flipbook for Part visuals ("decal layers").

	Each Decal / Texture directly under the RenderTemplate is a layer, identified by its name (an
	occurrence index breaks ties). Layer settings are attributes on that RT decal:
	  LayerTransparency / LayerColor / LayerBrightness  graphs over life (nil = 0 / authored Color3 / 1)
	  LayerFlipbook       name of a MeshFlipbooks sub-folder; nil = the first layer inherits the legacy
	                      flat frames, "None" = no flipbook
	  LayerFlipbookMode / LayerFlipbookFramerate / LayerFlipbookStartRandom / LayerFlipbookReverse
	                      nil = inherit the part-level Flipbook settings
	  LayerActive         inventory insert target (UI only)
	On a Part + SpecialMesh visual with textured mesh frames the first decal's texture is written by
	Modules/Part/MeshFrames per mesh frame, so that layer runs no flipbook of its own.
	MeshFlipbooks holds one sub-folder of numbered frames per flipbook; numbered frames directly in the
	folder are the legacy single flipbook (set "").

	Config attribute DecalLayers (Transform stamps true; Migrate promotes legacy items) selects the mode:
	true = the part's Transparency / Color / Brightness graphs drive the MESH and layers drive their
	decals; false / nil = legacy (part graphs drive the first decal). Emit / EmitAnimate / Update branch
	on data.DecalLayersMode / pData.DecalLayersMode.

	Mutates clone decals (Emit) or the LIVE RT decals (Animate: snapshot at attach, restore() on finish
	and cancel). refresh() re-reads graphs per AnimateLoop cycle. write() allocates nothing but the
	Color3 it assigns.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)

local DecalLayers = {}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function isLayerInstance(inst)
	return inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture")
end

-- Ordered layer descriptors from the RT's direct Decal / Texture children.
local function readLayers(rt)
	local layers = {}
	if not rt then return layers end
	local seen = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(rt:GetChildren()) do
		if not isLayerInstance(child) then continue end
		seen[child.Name] = (seen[child.Name] or 0) + 1
		local color = child:GetAttribute("LayerColor")
		if typeof(color) ~= "ColorSequence" then color = ColorSequence.new(child.Color3) end
		table.insert(layers, {
			name = child.Name,
			occurrence = seen[child.Name],
			texture = child.Texture,
			transparency = child:GetAttribute("LayerTransparency"),
			color = color,
			brightness = child:GetAttribute("LayerBrightness"),
			flipbook = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbook"),
			mode = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookMode"),
			framerate = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookFramerate"),
			startRandom = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookStartRandom"),
			reverse = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookReverse"),
		})
	end
	return layers
end

-- GetData hook: mode flag, flipbook sets, layer descriptors. CachedMeshTextures keeps the flat set
-- (or the first sub-folder by name) for SurfaceAppearance, MeshPart and legacy targets.
function DecalLayers.readInto(data, item, config)
	data.DecalLayersMode = config:GetAttribute("DecalLayers") == true
	data.MeshFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
	data.MeshFlipbookSets = data.MeshFlipbooks and MeshFlipMod.GetFlipbookSets(data.MeshFlipbooks) or {}
	data.CachedMeshTextures = data.MeshFlipbookSets[""]
	if not data.CachedMeshTextures then
		local names = {}
		for name in pairs(data.MeshFlipbookSets) do table.insert(names, name) end
		table.sort(names)
		if names[1] then data.CachedMeshTextures = data.MeshFlipbookSets[names[1]] end
	end
	data.DecalLayers = data.DecalLayersMode and readLayers(item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")) or {}
end

-- Frames for a layer: its assigned sub-folder, or the legacy flat set for an unassigned first layer.
local function framesFor(data, layer, index)
	local key = layer.flipbook
	if key == "None" then return nil end
	if key == nil or key == "" then
		if index == 1 then return data.MeshFlipbookSets[""] end
		return nil
	end
	return data.MeshFlipbookSets[key]
end

-- Bind descriptors to the visual's decals (name + occurrence), write t=0 and start the flipbooks.
-- liveSource = Animate on the RT itself: snapshot for restore(), never cycle textures on it.
function DecalLayers.attach(pData, data, visualPart, lifetime, liveSource)
	pData.Layers = nil
	local descriptors = data.DecalLayers
	if not data.DecalLayersMode or not descriptors or #descriptors == 0 then return end
	local particle = data.ParticleData
	local byKey = {}
	for index, desc in ipairs(descriptors) do byKey[desc.name .. "#" .. desc.occurrence] = index end
	local meshFramesOwnFirst = data.MeshFramesTextured == true and visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil
	local seen = {}
	local layers = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(visualPart:GetChildren()) do
		if not isLayerInstance(child) then continue end
		seen[child.Name] = (seen[child.Name] or 0) + 1
		local index = byKey[child.Name .. "#" .. seen[child.Name]]
		local desc = index and descriptors[index]
		if not desc then continue end
		local entry = {
			decal = child,
			transparency = desc.transparency, color = desc.color, brightness = desc.brightness,
			transparencySeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.transparency),
			brightnessSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.brightness),
		}
		if liveSource then
			entry.snapshot = { transparency = child.Transparency, color = child.Color3, texture = child.Texture }
		elseif meshFramesOwnFirst and index == 1 then
			-- Texture written per mesh frame by MeshFrames.
		else
			local frames = framesFor(data, desc, index)
			local mode = desc.mode or (particle.FlipbookMode and particle.FlipbookMode.Name) or "None"
			if frames and #frames > 0 and mode ~= "None" then
				local framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(desc.framerate or particle.FlipbookFramerate or NumberRange.new(30))
				local startRandom = desc.startRandom
				if startRandom == nil then startRandom = particle.FlipbookStartRandom end
				local reverse = desc.reverse
				if reverse == nil then reverse = particle.FlipbookReverse end
				entry.flip = MeshFlipMod.layerState(child, frames, mode, framerate, startRandom, reverse)
			else
				-- A pooled clone may still show the previous emit's last frame.
				child.Texture = desc.texture
			end
		end
		table.insert(layers, entry)
	end
	if #layers == 0 then return end
	pData.Layers = layers
	DecalLayers.write(pData, 0)
	if not liveSource then MeshFlipMod.FlipLayers(pData, layers, lifetime) end
end

-- Stepped write at normalized life t; honours the event payload's SkipTransparency / SkipColor.
function DecalLayers.write(pData, t)
	local layers = pData.Layers
	if not layers then return end
	for i = 1, #layers do
		local layer = layers[i]
		local decal = layer.decal
		local trans = layer.transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, layer.transparency, layer.transparencySeed) or 0
		local bright = layer.brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, layer.brightness, layer.brightnessSeed) or 1
		local color = layer.color and GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, layer.color) or WHITE
		if not pData.SkipTransparency then decal.Transparency = trans end
		if not pData.SkipColor then
			decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * bright, color.G * 255 * bright, color.B * 255 * bright)
		end
	end
end

-- Animate finish / cancel: put the live RT decals back exactly as attach() found them.
function DecalLayers.restore(pData)
	local layers = pData.Layers
	if not layers then return end
	for i = 1, #layers do
		local layer = layers[i]
		local snap = layer.snapshot
		if snap and layer.decal.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				layer.decal.Transparency = snap.transparency
				layer.decal.Color3 = snap.color
				layer.decal.Texture = snap.texture
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- AnimateLoop cycle: re-read the graphs (and roll fresh envelope seeds) for the bound decals.
function DecalLayers.refresh(pData, freshData)
	local layers = pData.Layers
	if not layers or not freshData.DecalLayers then return end
	local byKey = {}
	for _, desc in ipairs(freshData.DecalLayers) do byKey[desc.name .. "#" .. desc.occurrence] = desc end
	local seen = {}
	for i = 1, #layers do
		local layer = layers[i]
		local name = layer.decal.Name
		seen[name] = (seen[name] or 0) + 1
		local desc = byKey[name .. "#" .. seen[name]]
		if desc then
			layer.transparency, layer.color, layer.brightness = desc.transparency, desc.color, desc.brightness
			layer.transparencySeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.transparency)
			layer.brightnessSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.brightness)
		end
	end
end

return DecalLayers

--[[
	Distortion Mixin  -  Emit + Animate + Update for screen-space distortion
	emitters (glass canvas fields: Ripple / Wave / Noise / Bulge / Pinch).

	No visual clone: pData.VisualPart is nil (every engine teardown path guards
	it  -  CameraShake contract). Each live effect projects its epicenter to the
	screen, samples its Amplitude envelope (step-gated), integrates phase from
	effective time (Timescale-reversible), and pushes ONE contribution into
	Distortion/Canvas; Engine composites all contributions onto the shared glass
	plane once per step, AFTER CameraShakeApply.

	Nested emitters UNDER a Distortion RenderTemplate never fire (no clone to
	link); Distortion AS a nested child of Part/Model works and its epicenter
	rides the moving parent clone.

	Known engine limits (documented): desktop graphics quality ~8+ only;
	transparent objects behind the canvas are invisible while a distortion is
	active  -  design for short bursts.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Canvas = require(script.Canvas)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

local KIND_IDS = { Ripple = 1, Wave = 2, Noise = 3, Bulge = 4, Pinch = 5 }

local warnedServer = false

return function(Particle)

-- Distortion discriminator; shared by init.luau Emit dispatch + Lifecycle EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isDistortion(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true
end

local function buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	local seeds = {
		Amplitude = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Amplitude),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local eff0 = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime)
	local speed = data.Speed or 3
	local pData = {
		Type = "Distortion",
		VisualPart = nil,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			Amplitude = data.Amplitude,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = eff0,
		_kindId = KIND_IDS[data.FieldKind] or 1,
		_wavelength = math.max(data.Wavelength or 1.5, 0.02),
		_speed = speed,
		_dirRad = math.rad(data.Direction or 0),
		_noiseScale = math.max(data.NoiseScale or 2, 0.05),
		_lensRadius = math.max(data.LensRadius or 1.5, 0.02),
		_screenCenter = data.EpicenterMode == "ScreenCenter",
		_falloff = data.Falloff or 0,
		_strength = data.Strength or 1,
		_amplify = data.Amplify or 0,
		_allowOver = data.AllowOverdrive == true,
		-- Mesh grid width request; the shared plane takes the highest active.
		_resolution = math.clamp(math.floor(data.Resolution or 24), 8, 96),
		-- Phase seeded from initial effective time so a reverse-start Timescale
		-- plays the field animation backward from its END state (family contract),
		-- not from a negative radius.
		_phase = eff0 * speed * 0.1,
		_noiseSeed = math.floor(math.random() * 100000),
		_lastOriginPos = item.Position,
	}
	-- Event origin override (EnableEmitAt / Events AtPosition chains): the
	-- epicenter projects from the resolved origin for the effect's whole life.
	if emitCtx then
		local originCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		originCF = originCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if originCF then pData._originOverride = originCF.Position end
	end
	return pData
end

function Particle:EmitDistortion(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	-- Server has no camera/screen; skip entirely.
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		if not warnedServer then
			warnedServer = true
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Distortion ignored on the server (no screen).")
		end
		return
	end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Nested emit: the epicenter rides the emitted parent clone.
	pData._parentLink = link
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: singleton persistent field per source (no clone at all).
function Particle:EmitDistortionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	pData._parentLink = link
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Per-frame update: envelope (step-gated) + phase integral (per frame) +
-- epicenter projection, then one Canvas contribution. Zero allocation.
function Particle:UpdateDistortion(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Lightning/init.luau UpdateLightning.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)
	if isDying then return true end

	-- Phase integral (Speed is signed; Timescale reverse rewinds the field).
	-- 0.1 keeps authored Speed values in a friendly 1-10 range.
	if not pData._timeFrozen then
		pData._phase += dtTs * pData._speed * 0.1
	end

	-- Envelope, step-gated by TotalKeyFrames.
	local li = newEff / lifeTime
	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(li, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local si = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		pData._curAmp = pData.Graphs.Amplitude and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Amplitude, pData.Seeds.Amplitude) or 0
		-- Above 1 = overdrive request (engine-quirk zone; effective ~4-10).
		local trans = pData.Graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)
		pData._curTrans = trans and math.clamp(trans, 0, 10) or nil
	end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return false end

	-- Epicenter: screen center, or the live world origin projected each frame
	-- (override → parent clone → source → frozen last-known).
	local epicU, epicV = 0.5, 0.5
	local atten = 1
	if not pData._screenCenter or pData._falloff > 0 then
		local origin = pData._originOverride
		if not origin then
			local link = pData._parentLink
			if link and link.Parent then
				origin = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link).Position
			else
				local src = pData._sourceItem
				origin = (src and src.Parent) and src.Position or pData._lastOriginPos
			end
		end
		pData._lastOriginPos = origin
		if pData._falloff > 0 then
			atten = math.clamp(1 - (cam.CFrame.Position - origin).Magnitude / pData._falloff, 0, 1)
		end
		if not pData._screenCenter then
			local vp, _ = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(origin)
			local vps = cam.ViewportSize
			epicU = vp.X / math.max(1, vps.X)
			-- Canvas plane-local V runs bottom-up; viewport Y runs top-down.
			epicV = 1 - vp.Y / math.max(1, vps.Y)
			-- Behind-camera fade (no 1-frame pop when the camera crosses the
			-- epicenter plane).
			atten *= math.clamp(vp.Z / 2, 0, 1)
		end
	end

	-- Contribute every live frame, even at amp 0: the transparency channel must
	-- stay continuous through amplitude zero crossings and Falloff/behind-camera
	-- fades, or the plane blinks (idle-dim pop mid-life). Canvas pulls the
	-- transparency toward 1 by atten so both channels fade together.
	local amp = (pData._curAmp or 0) * pData._strength * atten
	Canvas.accumulate(pData._kindId, amp, pData._wavelength, pData._phase,
		pData._dirRad, pData._noiseScale, pData._lensRadius,
		epicU, epicV, pData._noiseSeed, pData._amplify, pData._allowOver,
		pData._curTrans, atten, pData._resolution)

	return false
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch). Graphs/seeds/LifeTime
-- are refreshed by the generic replay; scalars re-read here. Phase reseed lives
-- in _reseedDistortionPhase, which EngineReplay calls AFTER it recomputes
-- _effectiveElapsed from the fresh Timescale graph + re-rolled LifeTime.
function Particle:_refreshDistortionAnimate(pData, freshData)
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._kindId = KIND_IDS[freshData.FieldKind] or 1
	pData._wavelength = math.max(freshData.Wavelength or 1.5, 0.02)
	pData._speed = freshData.Speed or 3
	pData._dirRad = math.rad(freshData.Direction or 0)
	pData._noiseScale = math.max(freshData.NoiseScale or 2, 0.05)
	pData._lensRadius = math.max(freshData.LensRadius or 1.5, 0.02)
	pData._screenCenter = freshData.EpicenterMode == "ScreenCenter"
	pData._falloff = freshData.Falloff or 0
	pData._strength = freshData.Strength or 1
	pData._amplify = freshData.Amplify or 0
	pData._allowOver = freshData.AllowOverdrive == true
	pData._resolution = math.clamp(math.floor(freshData.Resolution or 24), 8, 96)
	pData._curAmp = nil
	pData._curTrans = nil
	pData.CurrentStep = -1
end

-- Per-kind phase policy: Noise/Wave keep phase (continuous shimmer);
-- Ripple/Bulge/Pinch restart from the initial effective time so reverse-start
-- loops play backward from the end state. Must run AFTER EngineReplay's
-- _effectiveElapsed recompute (fresh Timescale graph + re-rolled LifeTime) or
-- ranged-Lifetime reverse loops seed the phase from the prior cycle's length.
function Particle:_reseedDistortionPhase(pData)
	if pData._kindId == 1 or pData._kindId == 4 or pData._kindId == 5 then
		pData._phase = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) * pData._speed * 0.1
	end
end

end

--[[
	Distortion/Canvas  -  the singleton screen-canvas compositor
	(CameraShake/Apply.luau role, but for the shared glass plane).

	Every live Distortion pData pushes ONE contribution per frame via
	Canvas.accumulate (scalars into preallocated parallel arrays  -  zero-alloc).
	Engine calls Canvas.applyFrame() once per step AFTER CameraShakeApply so the
	plane rides the shaken camera in the same frame: it evaluates every
	contribution into the shared height buffer (Distortion/Field), camera-locks
	the plane, and performs one vertex write pass.

	One plane per client, ever: overlapping glass planes cull each other, and
	the recipe Highlight would eat the 31-Highlight engine cap. Cross-engine
	(plugin + runtime module) ownership is first-claimant-wins via a heartbeat
	attribute  -  a newcomer seeing a live foreign canvas goes dormant instead of
	destroying it.

	Strength model: each contribution carries its sampled Transparency graph
	value; the plane takes the MIN across contributions (strongest glass wins,
	lower T = stronger refraction down to ~0.5, below that = dark semi-mirror).
	Transparency>1 is the overdrive zone (engine quirk, effective ~4-10): via the
	Amplify prop it engages only when EVERY active contribution opted in
	(AllowOverdrive veto); via the Transparency graph the MIN composition is the
	veto (any effect below 1 wins the plane). Either path latches permanently
	back to safe if the engine ever clamps the write (unpatched-bug dependency).

	Idle/parked visibility: Glass at Transparency 1 still renders sheen and the
	recipe Highlight leaves outline residue (engine quirk), so every idle window
	swaps to SmoothPlastic + disabled Highlight (setDimmed) and back on wake.
]]

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local Field = require(script.Parent.Field)
local PlaneBuilder = require(script.Parent.PlaneBuilder)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.Parent.VisualHost)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Log)

local Canvas = {}

-- Mesh plane hugs the camera (1 stud) so nearby world geometry rarely sits
-- between them; displacement is halfH-scaled so the look is distance-invariant.
-- Tile lenses stay farther out  -  at 1 stud their angular size would overlap
-- and overlapping glass culls itself.
local MESH_DIST = 1
local TILE_DIST = 3.5
local MESH_OFFSET = CFrame.new(0, 0, -MESH_DIST)
local MARGIN = 1.15
-- Vertex Z never exceeds this fraction of MESH_DIST toward the camera, so
-- extreme amplitudes cannot push the surface through the near-clip plane.
local HEIGHT_CLAMP = MESH_DIST * 0.45
-- Displacement tapers to zero across this UV band at the plane border: the
-- silhouette stays the flat covered rect, so edges never pull into view.
local EDGE_BAND = 0.12
-- Sun hole: glass refracts the SKYBOX, so a displaced field smears the sun
-- disc + bloom into a bright blob that reveals the plane. The field flattens
-- across a screen-space hole around the sun (flat glass there is invisible  -
-- verified). Squared radii; distances are aspect-corrected UV.
local SUN_HOLE_IN2 = 0.09 * 0.09
local SUN_HOLE_OUT2 = 0.26 * 0.26
-- Amplitude is authored in slope units; height = amp * halfH * SLOPE_K keeps
-- perceived refraction FOV- and resolution-invariant.
local SLOPE_K = 0.22
local IDLE_PARK_SECONDS = 2
local MAX_CONTRIB = 64
local BASE_TRANSPARENCY = 0.3
local HEARTBEAT_STALE = 1

-- Contribution parallel arrays (cursor reset every applyFrame).
local cKind = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cAmp = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cWavelength = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cPhase = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cDir = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cNoiseScale = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cLensRadius = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cEpicU = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cEpicV = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cSeed = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cAmplify = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cAllowOver = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cTrans = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cRes = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cursor = 0
local overflowWarned = false

-- Canvas state.
local meshCanvas = nil          -- PlaneBuilder.buildMesh result
local tileCanvas = nil          -- PlaneBuilder.buildTiles result
local building = false
local meshTierAvailable = nil   -- sticky probe result (nil = not probed yet)
local overdriveLatched = false  -- engine clamped a >1 write; stay safe forever
local idleSince = nil
local dormant = false           -- a foreign engine owns the canvas
local dormantWarned = false
local ownerSerial = math.floor((os.clock() % 1000) * 1000000)
local height = nil              -- sized per mesh build (resolution-dependent)
local tileHeight = table.create(PlaneBuilder.TILE_W * PlaneBuilder.TILE_H)
local baseU = nil               -- normalized coords, built lazily per tier
local baseV = nil
local tileU = nil
local tileV = nil
local edgeW = nil               -- per-vertex border taper (mesh tier)

local function buildNormCoords(w, h)
	local u = table.create(w * h)
	local v = table.create(w * h)
	for gy = 0, h - 1 do
		for gx = 0, w - 1 do
			local k = gy * w + gx + 1
			u[k] = gx / (w - 1)
			v[k] = gy / (h - 1)
		end
	end
	return u, v
end

-- Smoothstep taper from 0 at the UV border to 1 past EDGE_BAND.
local function buildEdgeWindow(u, v, count)
	local w = table.create(count)
	for k = 1, count do
		local d = math.min(u[k], 1 - u[k], v[k], 1 - v[k]) / EDGE_BAND
		if d > 1 then d = 1 end
		w[k] = d * d * (3 - 2 * d)
	end
	return w
end

-- Glass at Transparency 1 still renders sheen + Highlight outline residue
-- (engine quirk), so idle windows swap to SmoothPlastic with the Highlight off.
-- Transition-only writes; dimmed guard keeps this out of the per-frame path.
-- applyDimToMesh is unconditional so a freshly swapped-in mesh (resolution
-- upgrade) inherits the current dim state.
local dimmed = false
local function applyDimToMesh()
	if not meshCanvas then return end
	local part = meshCanvas.part
	part.Material = dimmed and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or Enum.Material.Glass
	if dimmed then part.Transparency = 1 end
	if meshCanvas.highlight then meshCanvas.highlight.Enabled = not dimmed end
end
local function setDimmed(on)
	if dimmed == on then return end
	dimmed = on
	applyDimToMesh()
	if tileCanvas then
		local mat = on and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or Enum.Material.Glass
		for i = 1, tileCanvas.count do
			tileCanvas.tiles[i].Material = mat
			if on then tileCanvas.tiles[i].Transparency = 1 end
			local hl = tileCanvas.highlights[i]
			if hl then hl.Enabled = not on end
		end
	end
end

-- kindId: 1 Ripple, 2 Wave, 3 Noise, 4 Bulge, 5 Pinch (Distortion/init maps).
-- Called every live frame (amp may be 0); atten pulls the transparency channel
-- toward 1 so distance/behind-camera fades stay continuous alongside amp.
-- res = requested mesh grid width; the plane is shared, so the HIGHEST active
-- request wins (async rebuild, never downgraded until teardown).
function Canvas.accumulate(kindId, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad, noiseScale, lensRadius, epicU, epicV, seed, amplify, allowOver, trans, atten, res)
	if dormant then return end
	if cursor >= MAX_CONTRIB then
		if not overflowWarned then
			overflowWarned = true
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Distortion: more than " .. MAX_CONTRIB .. " simultaneous effects; extras dropped this frame")
		end
		return
	end
	cursor += 1
	cKind[cursor] = kindId
	cAmp[cursor] = amp
	cWavelength[cursor] = wavelength
	cPhase[cursor] = phase
	cDir[cursor] = dirRad
	cNoiseScale[cursor] = noiseScale
	cLensRadius[cursor] = lensRadius
	cEpicU[cursor] = epicU
	cEpicV[cursor] = epicV
	cSeed[cursor] = seed
	cAmplify[cursor] = amplify
	cAllowOver[cursor] = allowOver
	-- Graph values above 1 request overdrive directly; the atten pull toward 1
	-- works from both sides (1 - (1-t)*a fades 6 -> 1 as atten -> 0).
	local t = math.clamp(trans or BASE_TRANSPARENCY, 0, 10)
	local a = math.clamp(atten or 1, 0, 1)
	cTrans[cursor] = 1 - (1 - t) * a
	cRes[cursor] = res or PlaneBuilder.RES_W
end

-- A foreign live canvas (other engine) parents under the same root with a heartbeat.
local function foreignCanvasLive()
	local existing = VisualHost.root():FindFirstChild("__PartIclesDistortion")
	if not existing then return false end
	if existing:GetAttribute("_ownerSerial") == ownerSerial then return false end
	local hb = existing:GetAttribute("_hb")
	if typeof(hb) == "number" and (os.clock() - hb) < HEARTBEAT_STALE then
		return true
	end
	-- Stale heartbeat: prior owner died without cleanup. Take over.
	pcall(function() existing:Destroy() end)
	return false
end

local function goDormant()
	dormant = true
	if not dormantWarned then
		dormantWarned = true
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Distortion: another Part-Icles engine owns the screen canvas; this engine's distortions are disabled")
	end
end

-- Bumped by reset(); an async mesh build that resumes after a teardown must
-- discard its result instead of parenting an orphan the sweep already missed.
local buildGen = 0

-- Grid height from width, keeping the canonical 24:14 aspect.
local function deriveResH(resW)
	return math.max(4, math.floor(resW * PlaneBuilder.RES_H / PlaneBuilder.RES_W + 0.5))
end

-- Install a finished mesh build as the live canvas (initial build or resolution
-- upgrade swap): destroy-then-parent runs in one thread, so no frame renders
-- without a plane. Sizes the resolution-dependent buffers.
local function installMeshBuild(built)
	local old = meshCanvas
	meshCanvas = nil
	if old then
		pcall(function() old.part:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() old.em:Destroy() end)
	end
	built.part:SetAttribute("_ownerSerial", ownerSerial)
	built.part:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	built.part.Transparency = BASE_TRANSPARENCY
	built.part.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent()
	meshCanvas = built
	local count = built.resW * built.resH
	baseU, baseV = buildNormCoords(built.resW, built.resH)
	edgeW = buildEdgeWindow(baseU, baseV, count)
	height = table.create(count)
	applyDimToMesh()
end

local function ensureCanvas(targetResW)
	if meshCanvas or tileCanvas or building then return end
	if foreignCanvasLive() then
		goDormant()
		return
	end
	if meshTierAvailable == nil then
		meshTierAvailable = PlaneBuilder.probeMesh()
	end
	building = true
	local myGen = buildGen
	task.spawn(function()
		if meshTierAvailable then
			local built = PlaneBuilder.buildMesh(targetResW, deriveResH(targetResW))
			-- CreateMeshPartAsync yields; reset() may have run meanwhile.
			if buildGen ~= myGen then
				if built then
					pcall(function() built.part:Destroy() end)
					pcall(function() built.em:Destroy() end)
				end
				return
			end
			if built then
				installMeshBuild(built)
				building = false
				return
			end
			-- Mid-session memory/permission failure: demote for the session.
			meshTierAvailable = false
		end
		if buildGen ~= myGen then return end
		local tiles = PlaneBuilder.buildTiles()
		tiles.model:SetAttribute("_ownerSerial", ownerSerial)
		tiles.model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		tiles.model.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent()
		tileCanvas = tiles
		tileU, tileV = buildNormCoords(PlaneBuilder.TILE_W, PlaneBuilder.TILE_H)
		building = false
	end)
end

-- A higher-resolution request arrived while a lower-res mesh is live: build the
-- bigger grid in the background (old plane keeps rendering) and swap on
-- completion. Downgrades never happen until teardown (avoids rebuild thrash).
local function upgradeMesh(targetResW)
	building = true
	local myGen = buildGen
	task.spawn(function()
		local built = PlaneBuilder.buildMesh(targetResW, deriveResH(targetResW))
		if buildGen ~= myGen then
			if built then
				pcall(function() built.part:Destroy() end)
				pcall(function() built.em:Destroy() end)
			end
			return
		end
		if built then
			installMeshBuild(built)
		end
		building = false
	end)
end

-- Plane Transparency: overdrive via Amplify (MAX across contributions, engaged
-- only when EVERY one opted in), else MIN of the sampled per-effect Transparency
-- graphs. Graph values above 1 are direct overdrive requests; MIN keeps that
-- conservative automatically (any effect below 1 wins the plane). Never after a
-- clamp latch.
local function resolveTransparency()
	if cursor == 0 then return 1 end
	if not overdriveLatched then
		local allOver = true
		local maxAmplify = 0
		for i = 1, cursor do
			if not cAllowOver[i] then
				allOver = false
				break
			end
			if cAmplify[i] > maxAmplify then maxAmplify = cAmplify[i] end
		end
		if allOver and maxAmplify > 0 then return math.clamp(maxAmplify, 4, 10) end
	end
	local minT = 10
	for i = 1, cursor do
		if cTrans[i] < minT then minT = cTrans[i] end
	end
	if overdriveLatched and minT > 1 then return BASE_TRANSPARENCY end
	return math.clamp(minT, 0, 10)
end

local function evalContributions(buf, u, v, count, aspect, ampScale)
	Field.zero(buf, count)
	for i = 1, cursor do
		-- Zero-amp contributions carry only the transparency channel.
		if cAmp[i] ~= 0 then
			Field.accumulate(cKind[i], buf, u, v, count, aspect,
				cAmp[i] * ampScale, cWavelength[i], cPhase[i], cDir[i],
				cNoiseScale[i], cLensRadius[i], cEpicU[i], cEpicV[i], cSeed[i])
		end
	end
end

local function applyMesh(cam, wantT)
	local canvas = meshCanvas
	local halfH = MESH_DIST * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) * 0.5) * MARGIN
	local vps = cam.ViewportSize
	local aspect = vps.X / math.max(1, vps.Y)
	local halfW = halfH * aspect
	local part = canvas.part
	part.CFrame = cam.CFrame * MESH_OFFSET
	part:SetAttribute("_hb", os.clock())
	-- Coverage via Size X/Y (mesh XY is unit extents); Z stays 1:1 studs.
	part.Size = Vector3.new(halfW * 2, halfH * 2, canvas.meshSizeZ)
	-- Read-back latch: if the engine ever clamps a >1 write (bug patched),
	-- permanently fall back to the safe baseline for the session.
	part.Transparency = wantT
	if wantT > 1 and math.abs(part.Transparency - wantT) > 0.01 then
		overdriveLatched = true
		part.Transparency = BASE_TRANSPARENCY
	end
	local count = canvas.resW * canvas.resH
	evalContributions(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, halfH * SLOPE_K)

	-- Sun screen position for the hole mask. Plane-local V runs bottom-up while
	-- viewport Y runs top-down, so the sun V converts into baseV space.
	local sunOn = false
	local sunU, sunVbase = 0, 0
	local sunVp, sunInView = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(cam.CFrame.Position + Lighting:GetSunDirection() * 1000)
	if sunInView and sunVp.Z > 0 then
		sunOn = true
		sunU = sunVp.X / math.max(1, vps.X)
		sunVbase = 1 - sunVp.Y / math.max(1, vps.Y)
	end

	local em, ids, baseX, baseY = canvas.em, canvas.ids, canvas.baseX, canvas.baseY
	for i = 1, count do
		local z = height[i] * edgeW[i]
		if sunOn then
			local dx = (baseU[i] - sunU) * aspect
			local dy = baseV[i] - sunVbase
			local d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
			if d2 < SUN_HOLE_OUT2 then
				if d2 <= SUN_HOLE_IN2 then
					z = 0
				else
					local t = (d2 - SUN_HOLE_IN2) / (SUN_HOLE_OUT2 - SUN_HOLE_IN2)
					z = z * t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
				end
			end
		end
		if z > HEIGHT_CLAMP then
			z = HEIGHT_CLAMP
		elseif z < -HEIGHT_CLAMP then
			z = -HEIGHT_CLAMP
		end
		em:SetPosition(ids[i], Vector3.new(baseX[i], baseY[i], z))
	end
end

local function applyTiles(cam)
	local canvas = tileCanvas
	local count = canvas.count
	local vps = cam.ViewportSize
	local aspect = vps.X / math.max(1, vps.Y)
	evalContributions(tileHeight, tileU, tileV, count, aspect, 1)
	canvas.model:SetAttribute("_hb", os.clock())
	-- Transparency graphs on this tier scale tile opacity: minT 1 = faded out.
	local minT = 1
	for i = 1, cursor do
		if cTrans[i] < minT then minT = cTrans[i] end
	end
	local transFactor = 1 - math.clamp(minT, 0, 1)
	local camCF = cam.CFrame
	for i = 1, count do
		local dirCF = camCF * CFrame.Angles(canvas.pitchAng[i], canvas.yawAng[i], 0)
		canvas.writeCFs[i] = CFrame.lookAt(camCF.Position + dirCF.LookVector * TILE_DIST, camCF.Position)
		-- Idle tile invisible (T=1); strength pulls toward the verified sweet
		-- spot 0.5. Sign is lost on this tier (documented).
		local mag = math.clamp(math.abs(tileHeight[i]) * 2, 0, 1)
		canvas.tiles[i].Transparency = 1 - mag * 0.5 * transFactor
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(canvas.tiles, canvas.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

-- Same-frame camera weld: the RenderStep write alone lags native camera motion
-- (Studio editor camera, fast play-mode moves) by one frame, which reads as the
-- pane unsticking. The CFrame property signal fires on every camera write  -
-- including CameraShakeApply's  -  so the pane re-locks the instant the camera
-- moves. Mesh tier only (per-signal BulkMoveTo would be too heavy for tiles).
local camConn = nil
local camConnCam = nil
local function relockToCam()
	if meshCanvas and camConnCam and meshCanvas.part.Parent then
		meshCanvas.part.CFrame = camConnCam.CFrame * MESH_OFFSET
	end
end
local function ensureCamWeld(cam)
	if camConnCam == cam then return end
	if camConn then camConn:Disconnect() end
	camConnCam = cam
	camConn = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(relockToCam)
end
local function dropCamWeld()
	if camConn then
		camConn:Disconnect()
		camConn = nil
	end
	camConnCam = nil
end

local function parkCanvas()
	dropCamWeld()
	if meshCanvas then
		pcall(function() meshCanvas.part.Parent = nil end)
	end
